risks.reasoning: The latest comparable reporting period is the four months ended 30 April 2020. Net cash from operating activities was positive at RMB1,106,733 thousand and period-end cash and cash equivalents were RMB1,585,384 thousand. Under Protocol v1.1.1, non-negative operating cash flow is not operating cash burn, so monthly operating cash burn and cash runway are null and the risk is not applicable.

The accountants' report shows positive consolidated profit in every reported annual and comparable four-month period. The 2017-2019 annual periods contain zero loss periods, and the four-month 2019/2020 comparison also contains zero loss periods; therefore neither the two-period medium nor three-period high continuous-loss condition is met.

Comparable revenue for the four months ended 30 April fell from RMB1,151,843 thousand in 2019 to RMB1,148,500 thousand in 2020. The calculated growth rate is approximately -0.29023%, which is below 0% but above -20%; this meets the frozen medium revenue-growth threshold and not the high threshold.

For each disclosed Track Record Period, the five largest customers contributed less than 5.5% of total revenue and no single largest customer contributed more than 2.0%. These formal bounds exclude both the medium thresholds (largest >=30% or top five >=60%) and the high thresholds (largest >=50% or top five >=80%).

The business disclosure gives top-five supplier procurement shares of approximately 51.6%, 33.9%, 34.3% and 47.0%, and largest-supplier shares of approximately 19.0%, 11.2%, 8.9% and 19.0% for 2017, 2018, 2019 and the four months ended 30 April 2020, respectively. The maximum disclosed top-five share is 51.6% and the maximum largest-supplier share is 19.0%, both below the frozen medium thresholds.

The formal pre-IPO investment disclosure expressly states that Dr. Li was not granted any special rights in relation to the Company. This is specific transaction disclosure rather than generic constitutional redemption boilerplate, so no actual effective or restorable special redemption right is identified.

MATERIALITY_RESOLUTION_AMBIGUITY: twelve appeals remained pending at the Latest Practicable Date, with aggregate claims of approximately RMB55.5 million. The first-instance court had dismissed all 13 claims and management, relying on litigation counsel and an indemnity, considered the likelihood of plaintiffs succeeding on appeal extremely low and the matter not materially adverse. Because the matter was unresolved and the prospectus simultaneously provides an outstanding claim amount and an immateriality/low-probability assessment, materiality and resolution require review under the frozen policy. The provisional candidate severity is medium.

The core property business was already commercialized: the accountants' report records substantial property-sales revenue in every reported period, including RMB1,124,182 thousand for the four months ended 30 April 2020. The candidate condition of a non-commercialized core product with no product-sales revenue is absent.

evidence.exact_text: 根據日期為2020年6月27日及2020年6月29日的判決書，常熟法院駁回了原告在上述13宗訴訟中所提出的所有申索，認為原告有關終止彼等與常熟共築之間的相關預售合約的請求並無理據，因為(i)原告在購買前明確知悉陽台將採用「封閉式設計」，且相關預售合約已書面指明陽台將採用「封閉式設計」；及(ii)原告未能提供相關證據證明符合《中華人民共和國合同法》下有關預售合約的終止條件，即（其中包括）當事人一方違約致使不能實現合約目的。因此，原告的申索並無理據。
